mistakes.text: If she didn't find this room, she would still be crying alone.
mistakes.normalized: if she didn't find this room she would still be crying alone
mistakes.feedback_sk: Nájdenie izby je v minulosti, preto po „if“ patrí Past Perfect: „hadn't found“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Nalezení místnosti je v minulosti, proto po „if“ patří Past Perfect: „hadn't found“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Finding the room happened in the past, so the if-clause needs the Past Perfect: “hadn't found”.

mistakes.text: If she wouldn't have found this room, she would still be crying alone.
mistakes.normalized: if she wouldn't have found this room she would still be crying alone
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „if“ nepatrí „would“; správne je Past Perfect: „if she hadn't found“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „if“ nepatří „would“; správně je Past Perfect: „if she hadn't found“.
mistakes.feedback_en: No “would” after “if”; use the Past Perfect: “if she hadn't found”.

mistakes.text: If she hadn't found this room, she would still cry alone.
mistakes.normalized: if she hadn't found this room she would still cry alone
mistakes.feedback_sk: Plač by práve prebiehal, preto je lepší tvar s -ing: „would still be crying“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Pláč by právě probíhal, proto je lepší tvar s -ing: „would still be crying“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The crying would be in progress, so the continuous form “would still be crying” is better.

mistakes.text: If she hadn't found this room, she would have still been crying alone.
mistakes.normalized: if she hadn't found this room she would have still been crying alone
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Stále by plakala“ hovorí o teraz, preto v hlavnej vete: „would still be crying“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Pořád by plakala“ mluví o současnosti, proto v hlavní větě: „would still be crying“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Still crying” is about now, so the main clause needs “would still be crying”.

mistakes.text: If she hadn't found this room, she would be still crying alone.
mistakes.normalized: if she hadn't found this room she would be still crying alone
mistakes.feedback_sk: Prirodzenejšie stojí „still“ hneď za „would“: „would still be crying“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Přirozeněji stojí „still“ hned za „would“: „would still be crying“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Still” sounds more natural right after “would”: “would still be crying”.

mistakes.text: If she hadn't found this room, she would still be crying lonely.
mistakes.normalized: if she hadn't found this room she would still be crying lonely
mistakes.feedback_en: Use “alone” (without anyone); “lonely” means feeling sad about being alone.
